description: Desktop: Intel Core i9-14900KS (8P+16E, 32 threads), 64 GB, GeForce RTX 4090 24 GB on driver 615.71.09 (other sessions held some VRAM) plus the UHD 770 iGPU, Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS
provenance: Recorded on the LNX1 host (xenon), 2026-10-27, with read-only commands: the files as read, the nvidia-smi output as printed. Reduced: /proc/cpuinfo to its processor and model name lines, pci.ids to the two GPUs, sysfs to the files the probe reads plus one connector.
